name: National History Park – Citadel, Sans Souci, Ramiers
description: In northern Haiti, near the town of Milot, stand the ruins of Sans-Souci Palace and the vast mountaintop fortress of the Citadelle Laferrière. Built in the early 1800s just after independence, they were the first monuments raised by formerly enslaved people who had won their freedom. Visitors can explore the palace ruins, then climb toward the Citadel and the nearby buildings at Ramiers.
